functor: Free(G) -> Rel: objects map to visit-occurrence fibers; generators to consecutive-visit relations; identities to diagonal relations; words to relational composites.
warning: A formal path may map to an empty relation. Different formal words may have the same relation. This functor need not be faithful, and does not identify the path category with the overlap face-poset category or compose full dynamical subsystems.

systems.state_definition: Frozen legacy last-core labeling, descriptive only; visit-to-visit intervals include residence time. These are not newly validated metastable states.
systems.scope: Exact finite observation semantics: basin fibers are recorded visit occurrences; generator relations link consecutive occurrences within a run. Equality of basin labels alone does not permit splicing trajectories. No rates or physical clock are required.
